IGUI_MBLD_NeedFramework: Build Anything needs Minidoracat UI Framework (API revision 22 or newer). Update or enable it, then try again.
IGUI_MBLD_Source_Tip: Where the tiles come from: the base game or a mod.
IGUI_MBLD_OnlyAffordable_Tip: Hide items you lack materials or tools for. Counts your inventory, bags and items on the ground next to you.
IGUI_MBLD_Fav_NotSaved: Favorites could not be saved to a file. Make sure Zomboid/Lua/MinidoracatBuilder/favorites.txt is not open in another program or read-only; the whole list is saved again the next time you add or remove a favorite.
IGUI_MBLD_PadHint: LB/RB tab | A select, A again to build | Y favorite | B close
IGUI_MBLD_Catalog_Wait: Cataloging tiles. You can search what is done so far.
IGUI_MBLD_Catalog_Failed: The tile catalog stopped with an error. Reload the save to try again; if it still fails, include console.txt when you report it.
IGUI_MBLD_Empty_QueryHint: Try a shorter word, or switch to All sources and the All tab.
IGUI_MBLD_Empty_Fav: No favorites yet. Select an item and press Add to favorites (gamepad: Y).
IGUI_MBLD_Empty_Recent: Nothing used yet in this game. Items you press Build on show up here.
IGUI_MBLD_Empty_Only: You lack materials or tools for everything here. Turn off Only what I can build to see all.
IGUI_MBLD_Empty_None: Nothing on this tab matches. Set the source to All sources, or pick another tab.
IGUI_MBLD_Tip_Short: missing materials or tools, select it to see the list
IGUI_MBLD_Detail_Gone: Can no longer be built here. The admin may have turned off its source. Pick an item from another source.
IGUI_MBLD_Detail_WindowLocked: Permanently locked: this window can't be opened, but it can be smashed.
IGUI_MBLD_Refund_pickup: Removal: pick it up as usual (it can be moved).
IGUI_MBLD_Refund_scrap: Removal: vanilla dismantle, returns part of the materials.
IGUI_MBLD_Refund_builder: Removal: right-click "Dismantle (Build Anything)", which returns between 1 and all of each material.
IGUI_MBLD_Refund_none: Removal: only by smashing with a sledgehammer. No materials back.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_stairs: All three steps need a floor under them. A landing floor is added on the level above if there is none.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_roof: Keeps rain out. For the room to count as indoors (temperature), the level above also needs a floor. PgUp/PgDn changes the level; drag a row from the supported end.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_roofOpen: This piece does not keep rain out (eaves, decoration); the square below stays outdoors. PgUp/PgDn changes the level; drag a row from the supported end.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_light: Lights up only with power: self-built houses are not on the grid, so use a generator. A switch you place wires itself to the lights in the same closed room; right-click it and choose Wiring... to add or remove lights.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_lightStreet: Lights up only at night, and only with power: self-built houses are not on the grid, so use a generator. A switch you place wires itself to the lights in the same closed room; right-click it and choose Wiring... to add or remove lights.
IGUI_MBLD_WhatsNew: Street lights and lit signs you build now light up at night on generator or solar power.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_curtain: Hangs on the indoor side of a window frame. The square needs a roof or a floor above it.
IGUI_MBLD_DragShort: %1 tiles lack materials; together they still need %2
IGUI_MBLD_DragShortOne: 1 tile lacks materials; it still needs %2
IGUI_MBLD_Replace: This cancels the %1 tiles still queued from your last row
IGUI_MBLD_ReplaceOne: This cancels the 1 tile still queued from your last row
IGUI_MBLD_Stopped: Stopped after building %1 of %2 tiles (interrupted, or the way was blocked). Tiles not built used no materials; drag again to continue.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_OFF: The admin has turned off building.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_NOT_ALLOWED: Only admins can use Build Anything on this server.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_STATE: You can't build right now (in a vehicle or dead). Get out and try again.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_STALE: Building settings have changed. Reopen the window; no materials were used.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_BAD_REQUEST: The request was invalid. Reopen the window and try again.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_NO_INTENT: The build request expired. Build again.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_UNKNOWN: This item no longer exists. Reopen the window to refresh the catalog.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_UNSUPPORTED: This kind can't be built with Build Anything yet. Pick another item.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_DISABLED: The admin has turned off this tileset or its source. Pick an item from another source.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_BAD_FACE: This item has no such facing. Rotate to another facing.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_TOO_FAR: Too far. Stay within %1 tiles and at most one level apart while building.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_UNREACHABLE: You can't reach that spot from here (walls or closed doors in the way). Go around and try again.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_NOT_LOADED: That area isn't loaded yet. Move closer.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_SAFEHOUSE: This tile is in someone else's safehouse. Pick another tile, or ask the owner for build permission.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_PERM_DENIED: You don't have build permission here. Ask the safehouse owner.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_OUTSIDE_SAFEHOUSE: On this server you can only build inside a safehouse.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_BLOCKED: Something is in the way, or this spot can't hold it. Pick another tile or clear it.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_NO_MATERIAL: Missing %1. Put them in your backpack or on the ground next to you, then build again.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_NO_TOOL: Carry %1 with you, then build again.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_INTERNAL: Building failed. No materials were used. Try again; if it keeps failing, report it with your console.txt.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_WALK: Stopped before building anything (interrupted, or the way was blocked). No materials were used; build again.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_NO_ROOM: There's no free spot to stand next to tile %1. Clear a square beside it, or build somewhere else.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_NO_ROOM_One: There's no free spot to stand next to this tile. Clear a square beside it, or build somewhere else.
IGUI_MBLD_Refuse_Other: Couldn't build (%1). Try again; if it keeps failing, report it with your console.txt.
IGUI_MBLD_UnbuildRefuse_OFF: The admin has turned off building.
IGUI_MBLD_UnbuildRefuse_NOT_ALLOWED: Only admins can use Build Anything on this server.

IGUI_MBLD_UnbuildRefuse_BAD_REQUEST: The request was invalid. Try dismantling again.
IGUI_MBLD_UnbuildRefuse_NO_INTENT: The dismantle request expired. Try again.
IGUI_MBLD_UnbuildRefuse_TOO_FAR: Too far. Stay within %1 tiles and at most one level apart while dismantling.

IGUI_MBLD_UnbuildRefuse_NOT_LOADED: That area isn't loaded yet. Move closer.

IGUI_MBLD_UnbuildRefuse_NOT_EMPTY: Something is still inside or on top. Empty it first.

IGUI_MBLD_UnbuildRefuse_NO_TOOL: Carry %1 with you, then dismantle again.
IGUI_MBLD_UnbuildRefuse_INTERNAL: Dismantling failed. No materials were returned. Try again; if it keeps failing, report it with your console.txt.
IGUI_MBLD_UnbuildRefuse_NO_ROOM: There's no free spot to stand next to it. Clear a square beside it, then dismantle.
IGUI_MBLD_UnbuildRefuse_Other: Couldn't dismantle (%1). Try again; if it keeps failing, report it with your console.txt.
IGUI_MBLD_Wire_Hint1: Click a light to add or remove it. Click a wired switch to take it off.
IGUI_MBLD_Wire_Hint3: Click another switch to make it two-way; its whole circuit joins.
IGUI_MBLD_Wire_Hint2: Esc or right-click to leave. Gamepad: A add or remove, X wire this room, B leave.
IGUI_MBLD_Wire_Auto: Lights in this room wired to the switch: %1.

IGUI_MBLD_Wire_PickOf: (%1 of %2; click again for the next one)

IGUI_MBLD_WireRefuse_NOT_ALLOWED: Only admins can use Build Anything on this server.
